5:4: the Lord of sabaoth -- i.e. Jehovah of hosts.
3:1: masters -- teachers, knowing that we shall have the more severe judgment. Cf. Mark 12:40.
1:14: tempted -- "Temptation" is used in two senses: (1) Solicitation to evil (e.g. Genesis 3:1-6; Matthew 4:1; 1 Corinthians 10:13; 2 Corinthians 11:3,4; James 1:14). (2) Testing under trial (eg) Genesis 22:1; Luke 22:28 Cf Luke 4:2, Cf Matthew 6:13 (solicitation to evil) and 1 Peter 1:6 (testing under trial).
1:17: gift -- Two words are used in the original for "gift," the first meaning the act of giving; the second, the thing given.
2:1: the Lord of glory -- the Glory, i.e. in the sense of Hebrews 1:3 as taking the place of the shekinah. with respect -- In the presence of Christ the Glory, earthly distinctions disappear.
2:23: imputation -- Imputation is the act of God whereby He accounts righteousness to the believer in Christ, who has borne the believer's sins in vindication of the law. (See Scofield "Philemon 1:18"). righteousness -- (See Scofield "Romans 3:21").
